notes: Unresolved classifications are first-class results and must not be promoted to proofs.
This is the first closure unit; it is not general NURBS Boolean qualification.

included: degree 1..25 curves with at most 256 controls
degree 1..25 surfaces with 2..32 controls per axis
positive weights in [1e-12,1e12] with conditioning at most 1e12
outward-rounded per-span and per-cell hull/denominator certificates
planar surface normal regularity and explicit unresolved classification
analytic degree-one projection uniqueness and conservative global candidates
piecewise-linear interpolation and conservative Hausdorff approximation
zero-error insertion/elevation wrappers and exact affine monotone reparameterization
ToleranceContext identity/evidence through Rust, WASM, TypeScript and ModelGraph reports

notes: Evidence was written only after Rust core, bridge, WASM product and TypeScript tests passed.
